# Components

<!-- generated by packages/lesson/scripts/gen-docs.mts — edit the component definitions in packages/lesson/src/components, not this file -->

Models build lessons from these components. Each node is `{"id", "type", "slot"?, "enter"?, ...props}`; cues target a node (`"eq1"`) or one of its parts (`"eq1#tok:2"`).

**Generic actions** (any node or part): `show`, `hide`, `highlight`, `unhighlight`, `pulse`, `draw`, `dim`, `undim`, `color`.

## Core

### `title`

Title card that opens a lesson: optional kicker ("Unit 2, Chapter 5"), the title, an optional subtitle and up to 4 short lines (often the key example, e.g. "$7 − 3 = 4$"). Parts: kicker, title, subtitle, line:0…; lines appear one by one unless cued.

Default slot: `full`. Localized props: `kicker`, `title`, `subtitle`, `lines.*`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kicker` |  | string |
| `title` | yes | string |
| `subtitle` |  | string |
| `lines` |  | array |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "title",
 "kicker": "Unit 2, Chapter 5",
 "title": "Subtracting integers",
 "lines": [
  "$7 − 3 = 4$",
  "$7 + (−3) = 4$"
 ]
}
```

```json
[{"at":1.5,"do":"pulse","target":"x#line:1"}]
```

### `text`

One short line or paragraph of on-screen text: a caption, a rule, a key sentence. Wraps to its slot. Use $…$ for inline math. Keep it short; the narration carries the explanation.

Default slot: `title`. Localized props: `text`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | yes | string |
| `tone` |  | string |
| `size` |  | string |
| `weight` |  | string |
| `align` |  | string |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "text",
 "text": "Subtracting a number = adding its opposite",
 "tone": "chalk",
 "size": "lg"
}
```

### `list`

A list of 2–6 short items, e.g. the chapter summary (numbered takeaways) or steps. Each item may have a second line `sub` (an example, often math). Parts: item:0…; items appear one by one unless cued (cue "show" on item:i at the matching mark).

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `items.*.text`, `items.*.sub`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | yes | array |
| `style` |  | string |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "list",
 "items": [
  {
   "text": "To subtract, add the opposite.",
   "sub": "$a − b = a + (−b)$"
  },
  {
   "text": "Subtracting a positive number moves you left.",
   "sub": "$2 − 5 = −3$"
  }
 ]
}
```

### `definition`

A definition card: the term, its definition and an optional example. Parts: term, text, example.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `term`, `text`, `example`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `term` | yes | string |
| `text` | yes | string |
| `example` |  | string |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "definition",
 "term": "Additive inverse",
 "text": "The number you add to get 0.",
 "example": "$3 + (−3) = 0$"
}
```

### `callout`

A boxed note with a tone: info, tip, warn, mistake (a common error, shown crossed) or good. Use "mistake" to show the common mistake before the right way.

Default slot: `band`. Localized props: `text`, `title`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | yes | string |
| `title` |  | string |
| `tone` |  | string |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "callout",
 "tone": "mistake",
 "title": "Careful",
 "text": "$5 − (−3)$ is not $5 − 3$."
}
```

### `compare`

Two columns side by side to contrast ideas (before/after, wrong/right, two cases). Each side: title, 1–6 short items, tone (neutral, good, bad). Parts: a (first column), b (second), a:i, b:i. Column b appears after a unless cued. "first" is the reading-start side (right in Arabic).

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `left.title`, `left.items.*`, `right.title`, `right.items.*`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | yes | object |
| `right` | yes | object |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "compare",
 "left": {
  "title": "Wrong",
  "items": [
   "$5 − (−3) = 2$"
  ],
  "tone": "bad"
 },
 "right": {
  "title": "Right",
  "items": [
   "$5 − (−3) = 5 + 3 = 8$"
  ],
  "tone": "good"
 }
}
```

### `table`

A small table (≤ 6 columns, ≤ 8 rows) of short cells. Parts: row:i, col:j, cell:i:j (0-based, rows exclude the header) — highlight a row or cell as the narration mentions it.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `columns.*`, `rows.*.*`, `caption`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | yes | array |
| `rows` | yes | array |
| `caption` |  | string |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "table",
 "columns": [
  "Item",
  "Price"
 ],
 "rows": [
  [
   "Pen",
   "3 MAD"
  ],
  [
   "Notebook",
   "12 MAD"
  ]
 ]
}
```

### `flow`

A process: 2–6 short steps joined by arrows (row follows reading direction; column goes down). cycle: true joins the last step back to the first. Parts: step:i, arrow:i; steps appear in order unless cued.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `steps.*`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | yes | array |
| `direction` |  | string |
| `cycle` |  | boolean |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "flow",
 "steps": [
  "Evaporation",
  "Condensation",
  "Precipitation",
  "Collection"
 ],
 "cycle": true
}
```

### `image`

A picture: a figure cropped from the source PDF, an illustration or a photo. src is a path inside the book (assets/…); or give prompt (a description) and Warqa generates the illustration. alt describes it for screen readers.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `alt`, `caption`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` |  | string |
| `prompt` |  | string |
| `alt` | yes | string |
| `caption` |  | string |
| `fit` |  | string |

## STEM

### `equation`

A row of math tokens that transforms step by step. steps is a list of token rows; tokens at the same position (or with the same id) match across steps: a changed token gets a box and morphs, removed tokens shrink away, new tokens fade in. Token: a string ("7", " − ", "(−3)") or {t, id, c (colour), note (small label under it), frac: ["3","4"], sup: "2" (exponent), sub: "n" (index)}. Action "step" moves to the next row (or {to: k}). Parts: tok:<id> (default id = position, e.g. tok:1), note:<id> (hidden until shown). A step may instead be a TeX-like string, split into tokens automatically: "x^2 + 2x + 1", "\frac{3}{4} = 0.75", "a_n = 2n + 1", "\sqrt{9} = 3" (use token arrays when you need colours, notes or ids). Use for rewriting an expression ("keep, change, change"), simplifying, or appending "= 4".

Default slot: `upper`. Localized props: `steps.*.*.note`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | yes | array |
| `size` |  | string |

- **action `step`** — Morph to the next step (or {to: k}, 0-based). Takes about 1.4 s per step. Args: `{"to":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "equation",
 "steps": [
  [
   "7",
   " − ",
   "3"
  ],
  [
   "7",
   " + ",
   "3"
  ],
  [
   "7",
   " + ",
   {
    "t": "(−3)",
    "c": "coral"
   }
  ],
  [
   "7",
   " + ",
   {
    "t": "(−3)",
    "c": "coral"
   },
   " = ",
   "4"
  ]
 ]
}
```

```json
[{"at":0.5,"do":"step","target":"x"},{"at":2.2,"do":"step","target":"x"},{"at":4,"do":"step","target":"x"}]
```

### `math`

Display math typeset from TeX (MathJax): nested fractions, roots, matrices, sums, integrals, aligned derivations — anything the token-based "equation" cannot show. steps: TeX strings (write \frac, \sqrt, \begin{pmatrix}…). mode "replace" (default) shows one step at a time and cross-fades to the next with action "step"; mode "stack" is a derivation: lines appear one under the other, aligned on "=", with action "step" (or show line:i). Mark parts to point at with \part{name}{…}, e.g. "\part{num}{x+1} \over 2", then highlight "m#part:num". Parts: line:i (stack mode), part:<name>. Prefer "equation" for simple one-line arithmetic that should morph token by token.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: none.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | yes | array |
| `mode` |  | string |
| `size` |  | string |
| `color` |  | string |

- **action `step`** — Next step: cross-fade to the next formula (replace mode) or show the next line (stack mode). {to: k} jumps. Args: `{"to":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "math",
 "steps": [
  "\\frac{\\part{num}{2x + 4}}{2}",
  "\\frac{2(x + 2)}{2}",
  "x + 2"
 ]
}
```

```json
[{"at":0.8,"do":"highlight","target":"x#part:num"},{"at":1.6,"do":"step","target":"x"},{"at":3,"do":"step","target":"x"}]
```

### `numberline`

A horizontal number line from min to max (≤ 40 ticks; stays left-to-right in every language). Actions: dot {at, color?, label?} lands a dot; hop {from, to, level? 1–3, color?, label?} draws an arrow above the line (default colour sky for right, coral for left, label "+n"/"−n"); arc {from, to, color?} a curved arc (e.g. mirror images); vline {at, label?, color?} a vertical marker. Parts: tick:<value> (pickable), and each mark by its id (pass id to name it, e.g. "h1").

Default slot: `lower`. Localized props: none.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | yes | number |
| `max` | yes | number |
| `step` |  | number |
| `labels` |  | string |

- **action `dot`** — Land a dot on a value. Args: `{"at":{"type":"number"},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `hop`** — Draw an arrow from one value to another above the line. Args: `{"from":{"type":"number"},"to":{"type":"number"},"level":{"default":1,"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `arc`** — A curved arc between two values. Args: `{"from":{"type":"number"},"to":{"type":"number"},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `vline`** — A vertical line at a value with an optional label (e.g. "mirror at 0"). Args: `{"at":{"type":"number"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "numberline",
 "min": -8,
 "max": 8
}
```

```json
[{"at":0.5,"do":"hop","target":"x","args":{"from":0,"to":7}},{"at":1.6,"do":"hop","target":"x","args":{"from":7,"to":4,"level":2}},{"at":2.6,"do":"dot","target":"x","args":{"at":4}}]
```

### `counters`

A row of identical tiles or counters to count, add or take away (kind pos = "+" tiles in sky, neg = "−" tiles in coral, plain = dots). Action remove {count, from: "end"|"start"} takes some away. Parts: item:i.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: none.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | yes | integer |
| `kind` |  | string |
| `color` |  | string |
| `symbol` |  | string |
| `perRow` |  | integer |

- **action `remove`** — Take counters away (they float up and fade). Args: `{"count":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":9007199254740991},"from":{"default":"end","type":"string","enum":["end","start"]}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "counters",
 "count": 7,
 "kind": "neg"
}
```

```json
[{"at":1,"do":"remove","target":"x","args":{"count":6}}]
```

### `vscale`

A vertical scale: a plain axis (heights, depths, sea level) or a thermometer with a level. zones shade ranges (e.g. under water). Actions: set {value} moves the thermometer level; marker {at, label?, color?} places a labelled point; brace {from, to, label?, color?} shows a distance. Parts: zone:i and marks by id.

Default slot: `start`. Localized props: `zones.*.label`, `unit`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | yes | number |
| `max` | yes | number |
| `step` | yes | number |
| `unit` |  | string |
| `style` |  | string |
| `value` |  | number |
| `color` |  | string |
| `zones` |  | array |

- **action `set`** — Move the thermometer level to a value. Args: `{"value":{"type":"number"}}`
- **action `marker`** — A labelled point on the scale. Args: `{"at":{"type":"number"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `brace`** — A bracket beside the scale from one value to another, with a label (a distance or difference). Args: `{"from":{"type":"number"},"to":{"type":"number"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "vscale",
 "min": -10,
 "max": 10,
 "step": 5,
 "unit": "°",
 "style": "thermometer",
 "value": 5,
 "color": "coral"
}
```

```json
[{"at":1,"do":"set","target":"x","args":{"value":-7}}]
```

### `barchart`

A bar chart of 2–10 labelled values (bars grow in order unless cued; a cue "draw" on bar:i grows one). Parts: bar:i (pickable).

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `bars.*.label`, `unit`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bars` | yes | array |
| `unit` |  | string |
| `max` |  | number |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "barchart",
 "bars": [
  {
   "label": "Rabat",
   "value": 560
  },
  {
   "label": "Ifrane",
   "value": 1100
  }
 ],
 "unit": "mm"
}
```

### `plane`

A coordinate plane (axes keep their mathematical orientation in every language). Actions: point {x, y, label?, color?}; plot {fn, color?, label?} draws y = fn(x) (fn uses x, + − * / ^, sqrt, abs, sin, cos, tan, log, ln, exp, pi; e.g. "2*x - 1"); line {from: [x,y], to: [x,y], extend?} a line or segment. Parts: marks by id; pick questions use pt:x,y.

Default slot: `start`. Localized props: none.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` |  | array |
| `y` |  | array |
| `step` |  | number |
| `grid` |  | boolean |
| `labels` |  | boolean |

- **action `point`** — Plot a point. Args: `{"x":{"type":"number"},"y":{"type":"number"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `plot`** — Draw the graph of y = fn(x). Args: `{"fn":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `line`** — A segment between two points (extend: true draws the whole line). Args: `{"from":{"type":"array","prefixItems":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"number"}],"items":false,"minItems":2,"maxItems":2},"to":{"type":"array","prefixItems":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"number"}],"items":false,"minItems":2,"maxItems":2},"extend":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`


### `fractionbar`

One to four fraction bars stacked to compare fractions: each bar has parts (denominator), shaded parts and an optional label (e.g. "$3/4$"). Actions: shade {bar, to} animates the shaded amount; split {bar, parts} cuts the bar into more parts (equivalent fractions). Parts: bar:i (pickable).

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `bars.*.label`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bars` | yes | array |

- **action `shade`** — Animate how many parts of a bar are shaded. Args: `{"bar":{"default":0,"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"to":{"type":"number","minimum":0}}`
- **action `split`** — Cut a bar into a new number of equal parts (the shaded amount keeps its size). Args: `{"bar":{"default":0,"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"parts":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":48}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "fractionbar",
 "bars": [
  {
   "parts": 2,
   "shaded": 1,
   "label": "$1/2$"
  },
  {
   "parts": 4,
   "shaded": 2,
   "label": "$2/4$",
   "color": "coral"
  }
 ]
}
```

```json
[{"at":1,"do":"split","target":"x","args":{"bar":0,"parts":4}}]
```

### `areagrid`

A grid of unit squares (area model): rows × cols, with optional labels along the edges (e.g. "x", "3"). Action fill {r0, c0, r1, c1, color, label?} shades a block of cells (inclusive, 0-based). Parts: cell:r:c (pickable) and fills by id.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `caption`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | yes | integer |
| `cols` | yes | integer |
| `unit` |  | number |
| `rowLabels` |  | array |
| `colLabels` |  | array |
| `caption` |  | string |

- **action `fill`** — Shade a rectangular block of cells. Args: `{"r0":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"c0":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"r1":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"c1":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "areagrid",
 "rows": 3,
 "cols": 4,
 "rowLabels": [
  "3"
 ],
 "colLabels": [
  "4"
 ]
}
```

```json

```

### `balance`

A balance scale for equations: items (short math, e.g. "$x + 2$", "$6$") on the left and right pans. Actions: tilt {to: −20…20} (positive = left side down), put {side: "left"|"right", text, color?}, take {side, index}. Use it to show that both sides stay equal. Parts: left:i, right:i.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: none.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `left` |  | array |
| `right` |  | array |
| `tilt` |  | number |

- **action `tilt`** — Tilt the beam (degrees; positive = left pan down, 0 = level). Args: `{"to":{"type":"number","minimum":-25,"maximum":25}}`
- **action `put`** — Put an item on a pan. Args: `{"side":{"type":"string","enum":["left","right"]},"text":{"type":"string","maxLength":30},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`
- **action `take`** — Take an item off a pan (index among the original items). Args: `{"side":{"type":"string","enum":["left","right"]},"index":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "balance",
 "left": [
  "$x + 2$"
 ],
 "right": [
  "$6$"
 ],
 "tilt": 0
}
```

```json
[{"at":1,"do":"take","target":"x","args":{"side":"left","index":0}}]
```

## Humanities

### `timeline`

A timeline of 2–8 dated events in order (it runs in the reading direction: right to left in Arabic). Each event: date (as written, e.g. "1956", "القرن 12"), a short title, optional one-line text. Parts: event:i, revealed in order unless cued.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `events.*.date`, `events.*.title`, `events.*.text`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | yes | array |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "timeline",
 "events": [
  {
   "date": "1912",
   "title": "Protectorate begins"
  },
  {
   "date": "1944",
   "title": "Manifesto of Independence"
  },
  {
   "date": "1956",
   "title": "Independence"
  }
 ]
}
```

### `conceptmap`

A concept map: 2–10 labelled ideas joined by arrows (cause → effect, part → whole, idea → example). Laid out in layers from the first node. Parts: node:<id>, edge:i; revealed in order unless cued.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `nodes.*.label`, `edges.*.label`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | yes | array |
| `edges` |  | array |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "conceptmap",
 "nodes": [
  {
   "id": "erosion",
   "label": "Erosion"
  },
  {
   "id": "water",
   "label": "Water"
  },
  {
   "id": "wind",
   "label": "Wind"
  },
  {
   "id": "ice",
   "label": "Ice"
  }
 ],
 "edges": [
  {
   "from": "erosion",
   "to": "water",
   "label": "caused by"
  },
  {
   "from": "erosion",
   "to": "wind"
  },
  {
   "from": "erosion",
   "to": "ice"
  }
 ]
}
```

### `map`

A map (Natural Earth): an area ("world", "africa", "europe", "mena", "maghreb", "morocco", "asia", "americas", "fit" = around what is highlighted, or [lonMin, latMin, lonMax, latMax]) with highlighted countries (English Natural Earth names, e.g. "Morocco", "Egypt", "France") and markers {lon, lat, label}. regions {layer, highlight: [{region, color?, label?}]} draws the regions of a country from a layer added to the book with `warqa geo add <ISO3>` (e.g. layer "MAR-ADM1": Morocco's 12 regions; region = its name or ISO code such as "MA-09"). Highlights and markers appear in order unless cued; action pin {lon, lat, label?, color?} adds a marker. Parts: c:i (country i), r:i (region i), pin:i (marker i); all can be picked in a "pick" question. Maps are never mirrored. pov "morocco" (default) draws Morocco including the Sahara provinces; "un" draws Western Sahara separately.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `highlight.*.label`, `regions.highlight.*.label`, `markers.*.label`, `caption`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `area` |  | union |
| `highlight` |  | array |
| `regions` |  | object |
| `markers` |  | array |
| `pov` |  | string |
| `caption` |  | string |

- **action `pin`** — Drop a marker on the map. Args: `{"lon":{"type":"number"},"lat":{"type":"number"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000},"color":{"type":"string","enum":["chalk","dim","faint","task","good","bad","coral","sky","gold","rose","mint","lilac"],"description":"Theme colour: chalk (main text), dim, faint, task (accent/highlight), good (right), bad (wrong), or one of six hues: coral sky gold rose mint lilac. Keep one meaning per colour within a lesson."},"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$","description":"Identifier: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter."}}`

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "map",
 "area": "maghreb",
 "highlight": [
  {
   "country": "Morocco",
   "color": "coral",
   "label": "Morocco"
  },
  {
   "country": "Algeria",
   "color": "sky"
  },
  {
   "country": "Tunisia",
   "color": "mint"
  }
 ],
 "markers": [
  {
   "lon": -6.84,
   "lat": 34.02,
   "label": "Rabat"
  }
 ]
}
```

## Any document

### `keyfigures`

Two to four big numbers with labels ("37 %" – "of students…"), for reports and papers. Parts: item:i, revealed in order unless cued.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `items.*.label`, `items.*.value`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | yes | array |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "keyfigures",
 "items": [
  {
   "value": "37 %",
   "label": "read every day"
  },
  {
   "value": "2×",
   "label": "more since 2020",
   "tone": "good"
  }
 ]
}
```

## Children's books

### `storypage`

A picture-book page: an illustration and the page text. The sentence being read is highlighted (read-along). image: a path in the book (assets/…); or prompt: a description to generate the illustration (with the book's illustration style). text defaults to the narration. layout: start / end (picture beside the text), top, full (picture behind, text in a band).

Default slot: `full`. Localized props: `alt`, `text`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` |  | string |
| `prompt` |  | string |
| `alt` | yes | string |
| `text` |  | string |
| `layout` |  | string |
| `readAlong` |  | boolean |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "storypage",
 "prompt": "A small fox reading under an argan tree, warm watercolor",
 "alt": "A fox reading under a tree",
 "layout": "start"
}
```

## Experimental (custom code)

### `widget`

EXPERIMENTAL — a custom interactive picture written as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and JS, no external files, no network). It runs in a sandboxed frame and receives the lesson clock as messages: window.addEventListener("message", e => { if (e.data.type === "warqa:time") draw(e.data.t) }) (also e.data.lang, e.data.dir). Use only when no built-in component can show the idea. title describes it for screen readers.

Default slot: `main`. Localized props: `title`.

| prop | required | type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | yes | string |
| `title` | yes | string |
| `height` |  | integer |

Example:

```json
{
 "id": "x",
 "type": "widget",
 "title": "A circle whose radius grows with time",
 "height": 300,
 "html": "<svg viewBox=\"0 0 400 300\" width=\"100%\" height=\"100%\"><circle id=\"c\" cx=\"200\" cy=\"150\" r=\"10\" fill=\"#f0b45a\"/></svg><script>addEventListener(\"message\",e=>{if(e.data&&e.data.type===\"warqa:time\")document.getElementById(\"c\").setAttribute(\"r\",10+Math.min(120,e.data.t*30))})</script>"
}
```
